text: On start, the orange tutorial line 'The NEXT line ... says what comes next' is drawn underneath the white help overlay (WASD walk ... E use), so both are partly unreadable.

Breaking a pot (B) needs the crosshair exactly on it; took me 4 look adjustments. The hint 'Look straight at one of your pots, close by' only shows 'B break the Moon' once aimed; worked. HUD text (MADE list, chores) covers the lower-left where pots sit at the wheel.

NEXT line 'Go closer with the lamp, then look at it steadily (1...' runs off the right edge of the 640px window; the counter (1 of N?) is cut off. First snake turned to a coiled rope after ~3 s of steady lamp-gaze: nice moment.

After E at the door: 'You sleep, and dream.' The dream is the same village, darkened, walkable; HUD stays fully up, clock runs BACKWARD (~6 game-min per second: 6:08 pm -> 4:02 pm by ~20 s) and NEXT says 'Nothing here seems strange'. No prompt says what to do or how long it lasts; it read as possibly stuck/looping.

Dream ended somewhere between 11:01 am (dream clock) and ~30 game-s later; now the screen is entirely black except one faint grey pixel-dot at centre, with no HUD, no caption, no clock. A player would very likely think the game has crashed/frozen here.

Codex after waking: pages 'The dream' (Brhadaranyaka 4.3.9-14) and 'The fourth' (Mandukya 2,7) with Devanagari, IAST, Hume translation and sources; plus 'Other schools' giving Advaita, Visistadvaita and Dvaita readings of tat tvam asi fairly. Excellent. Minor: left list entry 'The space in the pot' is clipped by the page panel. The codex did not open on its own; only the earlier 'new page' hint pointed at Tab.

V in after-mode: 'Watching  step back in (V)'; camera pulls behind and the player figure walks the village on its own. Works. But the orange caption '...Live the day as it comes, or step back' runs off the bottom of the 640x360 window (last line cut).

After waking, the chores list stays ('as you like') but there is no distance/direction hint for them any more (NEXT just says 'Nothing more is asked of you') and E at the well does nothing; I could not tell how to start the water chore without a guide. Ran out of time before trying the ghat/clay bank.
